extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology; automated placeholder ROS/inflammation notes were replaced with bounded claims directly supported by local XML/PDF/figure/supplement locators.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aβ peptides have direct antimicrobial activity in vitro, measured as MIC values against 12 organisms; Aβ42/Aβ40/rodent Aβ42 are active for several organisms while reverse and scrambled controls are largely inactive.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Aβ1-42, Aβ1-40, rodent Aβ42, reverse Aβ42-1, scrambled Aβ42, and LL-37 comparator
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is activity evidence, not a molecular pore/permeabilization mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aβ42 associates with E. faecalis cells after incubation, shown by anti-Aβ immunostaining; this supports bacterial surface binding but does not by itself prove membrane permeabilization.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No exact binding affinity or membrane-disruption measurement is tabulated locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AD temporal-lobe homogenate antimicrobial activity against C. albicans correlates with Aβ level and is attenuated by anti-Aβ immunodepletion, supporting an Aβ-mediated endogenous activity context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Aβ in AD brain homogenates against Candida albicans
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure panels are graph/image sources; exact plotted values beyond reported p/r statistics are not fabricated.
